channel.title: KnightZ: The Failing Light | Dev Log
channel.description: Daily development updates on KnightZ: The Failing Light by KSUIE_Gaming.

item.title: Dev Log #60: Real motion capture for the brigand
item.description: The brigand's attacks move to real motion capture after three other sources failed review. Seven sword clips, two three-step chains and a kick, are retargeted onto him and in review.

item.title: Dev Log #59: The brigand fights back
item.description: All eight brigand hit reactions are approved and in game, with heavy hits knocking him back several steps. The brigand also gets four new seax attacks built from Owain's own swings.

item.title: Dev Log #58: Sparks, blood and a flinching brigand
item.description: Blocks now throw sparks and hits draw blood, with stains, splats and pools after a sever. The brigand gets eight hit reactions, one for each of Owain's attacks, built to the blade's real contact path.

item.title: Dev Log #57: Every swing lands on the brigand
item.description: Owain's attacks get a set strike distance. He slides to it and faces the enemy before each hit, so every test swing from close and from 3 m landed on the brigand.

item.title: Dev Log #56: Slower, heavier swings
item.description: A melee rework begins. Owain's attacks play at their animated speed and chain on set combo frames, his body turn is aimed at the blade's full reach, brigands get longer tells, and enemies no longer pull the camera in.

item.title: Dev Log #55: Rag doll, aim and lock-on
item.description: Owain's clips get sound and prop markers, he drops his weapons and falls into a rag doll that stays on the ground, his hits land on the impact frame, his strikes are aimed at the enemy and the lock-on can switch targets.

item.title: Dev Log #54: The audit is done and the clips are in the fight
item.description: Owain's last blocks and five hit reactions finish his animation audit. All 90 edited clips are back in Unreal, the game picks the right variant and every clip plays at its own speed.

item.title: Dev Log #53: A shield bash for a broken guard
item.description: Owain finishes his parries, gets five broken parries that end in a shield bash and stun, and his first three blocks. 70 of his 76 clips are approved.

item.title: Dev Log #52: Bandage, cure, campfire and a parry for each side
item.description: Owain kneels to bandage his arm, sticks his sword in the ground to drink a cure, rests at a fire in three chained clips and gets a parry for each side. 61 of his 76 clips are approved.

item.title: Dev Log #51: Five ways to fall and one way back up
item.description: Owain gets a spike wall death, four random combat deaths that end in rag doll, and a shared knockout with a get-up. 57 of his 76 clips are approved.

item.title: Dev Log #50: The Restless get their rags
item.description: All 16 Restless body variants are approved with the neck seam fixed. The male clothes are refit closer to the body, and every garment gets a torn and soiled version, with worn hair, ragged trousers and damaged Roman armour.

item.title: Dev Log #49: Kicked free from the ground
item.description: Owain's downed struggle and escape are approved, with a matching clip for the crawling enemy. 53 of his 76 clips are approved, and 16 Restless body variants and nine generic heads are built in Blender.

item.title: Dev Log #48: A grapple built for two bodies
item.description: Owain's grapple struggle and shield shove escape are rebuilt as synced pairs with matching enemy clips. 51 of his 76 clips are approved.

item.title: Dev Log #47: Takedowns and reactions to a defended attack
item.description: Owain gets a pommel strike, two stealth thrusts, five reactions for parried and blocked attacks and a stamina stun. 49 of his 76 clips are approved.

item.title: Dev Log #46: Two finishers, built as paired clips
item.description: Owain's ground finisher and beheading cut are rebuilt with matching enemy clips, the crawling enemy gets five approach variants, and 44 of his 76 clips are approved.

item.title: Dev Log #45: Severing cuts and a stricter joint check
item.description: Owain's severing attacks and push kick are rebuilt and approved, a stricter joint check now runs on every frame, and 42 of his 76 clips pass the hand audit.

item.title: Dev Log #44: A heavy combo that leaves the ground
item.description: Owain's heavy attack now opens a three-swing combo: a downward cut, a shield smash and a jumping spin, all approved. The shield bash was rebuilt by hand and a push kick is in progress.

item.title: Dev Log #43: A three-strike chain and a heavy cut
item.description: 33 of Owain's 76 clips pass the hand audit. His three light attacks now chain into one combo with set click windows, and the heavy attack's downswing is rebuilt from key poses and approved.

item.title: Dev Log #42: Owain's sword arm, clip by clip
item.description: All 51 of Owain's combat action slots now play his own clips, all 76 of his demo clips are in Blender for a hand audit after a round trip check, and a new rule sets how he carries sword and shield.

item.title: Dev Log #41: Birds, fish and a clearing to fight in
item.description: A roe buck, an otter, a beaver, twelve birds and three fish complete all 36 planned animals with 898 clips, and a small combat demo level takes shape in Unreal.

item.title: Dev Log #40: Pigs, horses and deer
item.description: The goat completes the small herd, and a pig, a wild boar, a pony, a horse, a mule and three red deer join on three new family skeletons. Eighteen animals now carry 615 clips.

item.title: Dev Log #39: A wolfhound, a fox and the first sheep
item.description: A wolfhound (57 clips) and a red fox (49 clips) join the canine skeleton, and a ewe and a ram become the first animals on a new small herd skeleton with 22 clips each.

item.title: Dev Log #38: Two dogs and a wolf in Unreal
item.description: A herding dog and a hound joined the wolf on the canine skeleton, with 37 and 58 clips solved from their own breed data. The wolf was rebuilt to 14,000 triangles, exported to Unreal with all 64 clips and given 15 sounds cut from real recordings.

item.title: Dev Log #37: The wolf learns to hunt
item.description: The wolf got a reviewed model, a canine skeleton, real eyes and teeth, and a face rig built on DogFACS. Its 47-clip set covers gallops, flee turns, turn-bend layers, rest, howls, threats, a leap attack straight out of the gallop and a death, with 42 clips approved.

item.title: Dev Log #36: The ox walks and the Roman city falls
item.description: The ox is the first animal rigged and animated, with walk and trot timed from published cattle studies, idle and grazing sets, and a cow on the same skeleton, both in Unreal. A Roman ruin kit replaced over 15,000 stand-ins, and every remaining prop on the list was built.

item.title: Dev Log #35: A hundred props and the Roman road
item.description: About 100 new period props, a chapel set, the dead and bones made from images, 15 new materials and 9 decals replaced the grey boxes in the hub. Watling Street was built as a road kit and laid with Roman tombstones along its verge.

item.title: Dev Log #34: Walking by the numbers
item.description: Every walk on the three main bodies was scored on 35 measures from clinical gait research and rebuilt to match. Ground cover on all eleven regions was reshaped and set onto the land, and the rules for how the player grows stronger were settled.

item.title: Dev Log #33: Every river finds its way downhill
item.description: The new water now runs through all eleven regions, and the land along every creek and river was cut so the water always flows one way and can always be seen. The four women also got all twelve outfits rebuilt, with real capes, fitted gowns and period footwear.

item.title: Dev Log #32: Rivers that move, and creeks you can wade
item.description: The river and creek look was rebuilt and approved, starting where the Rea Brook meets the Severn. Every river in the test area is filled, the player can wade in, the live water simulation now costs 0.04 ms per frame, and the ground under the water is real creek bed.

item.title: Dev Log #31: Ten regions rebuilt, and the rivers start over
item.description: All ten region maps around the hub were rebuilt overnight from real elevation data, each with its own biome map and our own plants. The hub got the approved planting, and the rivers were cleared and restarted from one test stretch where the Rea Brook meets the Severn.
